headline: BLS E-Services subsidiary sells JLG business for ₹59.49 lakh
summary: Atyati Technologies, a BLS E-Services subsidiary, approved the slump sale of its JLG lending unit to TVAM Technologies. The deal involves a consideration of ₹59.49 lakh.

headline: SBI Funds appoints Giridhar Sanjeevi as independent director
summary: SBI Funds Management Limited appointed Giridhar Sanjeevi as an additional independent director for three years, effective September 29, 2026, following Moiz Miyajiwala's term completion.

headline: Marine Electricals bags Rs 250.78 cr order
summary: Marine Electricals wins Rs 250.78 crore order for power distribution systems from Marine Electricals (India) Limited. Execution period is 10-12 months.

headline: Adani Ports settles SEBI probe for ₹37 lakh
summary: Adani Ports and Special Economic Zone Limited received a SEBI settlement order regarding alleged listing regulation violations. The company and five directors agreed to pay ₹37,05,000 without admitting guilt.

headline: Adani Power settles SEBI case for ₹37.05 lakh
summary: Adani Power and three directors settled SEBI proceedings for ₹37.05 lakh regarding listing regulation violations. The company stated there is no material financial impact.

headline: Supreme Engg wins Rs 5.29 cr supply order from MHI
summary: Supreme Engineering secured a Rs 5.29 crore work order for superalloy supply. The order represents ~2.5x quarterly revenue but faces execution risks given negative ROCE and TTM net losses.

headline: GE Shipping to acquire 157,000 DWT Suezmax tanker
summary: GE Shipping plans to acquire a new-building 157,000 DWT Suezmax tanker, with delivery expected in H2FY29, expanding its fleet capacity.

headline: Stocks to Watch: NCC, Ellenbarrie, Power Mech in focus
summary: NCC bags ₹1,076 Cr AP order; Ellenbarrie wins ₹961 Cr BHEL deals. Power Mech Q1 profit up 11%. Check key moves.

headline: Tata Motors subsidiary buys 26% stake in Mateshwari E-Smart
summary: A Tata Motors subsidiary has acquired a 26% stake in Mateshwari E-Smart Mobility, marking its entry into electric bus operations and maintenance services.
